answer: Require every agent identity to be bonded to a verifiable stake held in escrow, like quartz crystal locked in a vault: a new agent enters the economy through a single narrow inlet where it posts collateral before it can transact. Reputation then accrues slowly in a shared lagoon of transaction history, so a fake identity starts with no trust and must pay real fees and time to earn any. Spinning up a thousand sock puppets means locking a thousand bonds, which costs more than any fraud they could commit.
